notes: Original procedural scene and textures; Three.js MIT is the only imported asset.
Beijing-inspired compressed game geography, not survey data.
Scene lighting, renderer, gameplay, actors and animated rain are supplied by the host.
Tree, curb and lane geometry is instanced. Landmark interiors and terrain climbing are not provided.
